name: Stamnos (Mixing Jar)
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “Stamnos (Mixing Jar)” by Chicago Painter (about 450 BCE), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 177. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
changelog: 1.0.0 — source-backed palette; ≥7:1 body text and ≥4.5:1 controls.
